title: How law firms lose institutional knowledge when lawyers leave
excerpt: When a senior associate walks out the door, so does much of what they knew about your precedents, your counterparties and your positions. Here is why that happens, and what firms can do about it.
author: Jonny Braden

title: What is AI-assisted contract drafting? A guide for transactional lawyers

author: Jonny Braden
